card.name: University rooms and academic staff terms
card.fires_on: Words in university web text that name a campus room, room number digit, or academic role or service, such as Room, Director, tutor, accommodations, teaching.

modes.label: Room names and numbers
modes.description: The word Room or a digit of a room number in a campus event location.
modes.example: Location: Fishery Sciences Building (FSH) room 10<<7>> http://washington.edu/maps/FS

modes.label: Academic roles and services
modes.description: Words for university staff or student support, such as Director, tutor, accommodations.

card.writes: It pushes down campus and school words such as campus, college and faculty, so the model is less likely to continue with a campus word.
card.plain: It lights up on university room numbers and academic staff or support words in campus pages.
